title: Nat Kobitz confirms being read into a UAP program

tellings.quote: Have you ever been read in to any kind of program involving unidentified aerial phenomena, alien technology?

plain: A man named Nat Kobitz confirmed that he had been "read in", that is, formally briefed into, a secret programme dealing with UAP, the official term for UFOs, and with alien technology. Ross Coulthart tells Michels he put the question to Kobitz directly, sometime between 2018 and 2020: "Have you ever been read in to any kind of program involving unidentified aerial phenomena, alien technology?" If true, it would mean such a programme exists and admits people to it.
